title: Tight Quantum Preimage Bounds for Multi-Round Sponges
summary: The first nontrivial quantum preimage-resistance bound for multi-round sponges is non-tight; determining its tight parameter dependence remains open.

formal_statement.body: For sponge constructions using more than one round, determine tight bounds on the preimage-finding success probability of a quantum adversary as a function of the quantum-query count $q$, output length $n$, capacity $c$, and round count $\ell$, in the model where the target output $y$ is fixed independently of the permutation $\pi$. The first nontrivial bound for this multi-round setting is non-tight, leaving its tight parameter dependence unresolved.

scope.domain: Quantum preimage resistance of multi-round sponge hash constructions.
assumptions: The target output is fixed independently of the permutation.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the tight dependence of quantum preimage-finding success probability on the query count, output length, capacity, and round count.

citations.label: Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers

progress.summary: The source presents the first nontrivial quantum preimage-resistance bound for sponges with more than one round and identifies it as non-tight. The stated result concerns a target fixed independently of the permutation.
citation_labels: Alexandru Cojocaru et al., Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers
